name: resource-local-wifi
description: Sequential resource transfers (20-120 KB) through a shaped pipe at a local-WiFi wire: 25 Mbps with 3 ms one-way latency - the hop between a phone and the node across the room. Fast enough that the engine is visible again, slow enough that the wire still meters it.
conformance: settled == received with byte-identical totals and zero failures; the pipe delays, it never drops
